about: The engine's results on made-up test cases only. No case here is a real filing, and no figure here comes from one. Each case gives the inputs and what the engine returned for them.
compare: Exact. Every output is a JavaScript number as the engine returned it, or a refusal message. The prove-the-numbers test in README.md re-runs every case and expects the same values.

howEachCaseRuns.cases: If baselineEdit is present, resolveBaselineEdit(baselineEdit, calc) supplies stoveStrata and fuelMix. If quantityInputs is present, computeQuantity(quantityInputs) supplies Q_pop and Q_m, and its own outputs are recorded. Then computePaaEr(inputs) when calc is paa, else computeLegacyEr(inputs). Only finite numeric outputs are recorded.
howEachCaseRuns.fnrbCases: computeScenario(scenarioInput). The recorded output is fNRB and the multi-national region, or the refusal message when the engine refuses with FnrbUnavailableError.

outputs.message: No official fNRB default covers Morocco. Enter your project's own value with its source; the tools publish national values for 90 countries and multi-national values for three regions only.
